question: F4 Bab 5
explanation:
中文：按答案纸选A（25%）。母亲XᴴXʰ与父亲XᴴY可产生四种等概率子代：XᴴXᴴ、XᴴXʰ、XᴴY、XʰY，其中只有XʰY是患血友病的男孩，占全部子代的1/4＝25%。若只考虑男孩，两种男孩组合中一个患病，则为1/2＝50%；本题答案纸采用全部子代作分母。
English: Follow the key: A (25%). XᴴXʰ × XᴴY gives four equally likely offspring: XᴴXᴴ, XᴴXʰ, XᴴY and XʰY. Only XʰY is an affected boy, so affected boys are 1/4 = 25% of all offspring. Among boys alone, one of two possible combinations is affected, giving 50%; this key uses all offspring as the denominator.
